query: CHP olağanüstü kurultay çağrı heyeti Sulh Hukuk Mahkemesi başvuru karar - latest status as of late June / early July 2026. Has Özgür Özel's team filed the application under Civil Code Art 75 requesting appointment of a 3-person çağrı heyeti to convene a CHP extraordinary congress? Has any court issued a decision?
answer:
## Summary

**Has the application been filed?** — **Yes.** On **Tuesday, July 14, 2026**, the Özgür Özel faction filed a case with the **Ankara Sulh Hukuk Mahkemesi** (Civil Court of Peace) requesting appointment of a **three-person çağrı heyeti** to convene a CHP extraordinary congress. It was pre-announced by CHP Spokesperson Zeynel Emre on July 13.

**Has any court issued a decision?** — **No.** As of late July 2026, no ruling, hearing date, or interim decision on the çağrı heyeti application has been reported. Crucially, the Turkish **judicial recess (adli tatil) began July 20, 2026**, pushing any decision to September.

**Key details:**
- **Legal basis:** Turkish Civil Code çağrı heyeti / court-appointed convening mechanism (TMK Art. 75), triggered because the Kılıçdaroğlu-led leadership did not process the congress demand.
- **Signatures:** 833 congress delegates (>2/3 of total membership), notarized, submitted June 17, 2026.
- **Request:** three delegates appointed solely to convene the congress, plus an urgent interim measure.

**Context:** The crisis stems from the May 21, 2026 "mutlak butlan" (absolute nullity) ruling by the Ankara BAM 36th Civil Chamber, which removed Özel's administration and installed Kılıçdaroğlu. A June 26 istinaf bid to force a congress was rejected. The mutlak butlan file reached the Yargıtay on July 20 but its review is deferred to September due to the recess. Related upcoming date: August 20 (YDK expulsion hearings for nine pro-Özel MPs).

Bottom line: **application filed (July 14, 2026); no court decision yet, and none expected before September 2026 due to the judicial recess.**

key_facts: Özgür Özel faction filed an application with the Ankara Sulh Hukuk Mahkemesi on Tuesday, July 14, 2026, requesting appointment of a three-person çağrı heyeti to convene a CHP extraordinary congress.
The move was pre-announced by CHP Spokesperson Zeynel Emre on July 13, 2026 at the TBMM.

The application rests on 833 congress delegates' notarized signatures (more than two-thirds of total congress membership), submitted June 17, 2026, which the Kılıçdaroğlu-led leadership did not process.
As of late July 2026, NO court decision, hearing date, or interim ruling on the çağrı heyeti application had been reported.
The Turkish judicial recess (adli tatil) began July 20, 2026, stalling civil proceedings until September; a çağrı heyeti decision is not expected before September.
Legal basis is the Turkish Civil Code çağrı heyeti / court-appointed convening committee mechanism (TMK Art. 75), triggered by leadership inaction.

The crisis originates from the May 21, 2026 'mutlak butlan' (absolute nullity) ruling by Ankara BAM 36th Civil Chamber, which removed Özgür Özel's administration and installed Kemal Kılıçdaroğlu as chairman.
A June 26, 2026 istinaf application to force an extraordinary congress was rejected.
The mutlak butlan file reached the Yargıtay on July 20, 2026 (57 days after the ruling), but review was postponed to September due to the judicial recess.
Additional key date: August 20, 2026 — Yüksek Disiplin Kurulu (YDK) hearing on expulsion of nine pro-Özel MPs.
